integrity: Proof supported by integral Lefschetz, Poincare duality, Schubert Pieri, primitive-lattice minors, and checked exact arithmetic; finite computations are not substitutes for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats general odd-dimensional pencils of two alternating forms with k=2 and n>=3. It uses the published affine paving and Betti-number theorem. The n=2 quintic del Pezzo fourfold is an already known calibration case. Quantum and equivariant rings, k>=3, and singular pencil degenerations are outside scope. Historical originality, particularly implicit general linear-section ring methods, is not independently certified.
title: Integral Chow rings of odd biisotropic two-plane Grassmannians
